steps.title: Access HubSpot Developer Dashboard
steps.purpose: Establish application identity and access developer credentials.
steps.whereToGo: https://developers.hubspot.com > "HubSpot Developer Account > Manage Apps > Create App > Auth tab"
steps.instructions: Navigate to https://developers.hubspot.com. Sign in and go to: "HubSpot Developer Account > Manage Apps > Create App > Auth tab".
steps.howToVerify: Confirm browser loads the developer dashboard at "HubSpot Developer Account > Manage Apps > Create App > Auth tab".

steps.title: Register New OAuth Application in HubSpot
steps.purpose: Registers your client identity with the authorization server.
steps.instructions: Click "Developer Portal > Apps > "Create app"". Complete the registration form fields: App name, Description, Logo, Auth Tab: Redirect URLs, Scopes.
steps.expectedOutcome: Application created in developer console. Client ID is generated.
steps.howToVerify: Verify application entry appears in dashboard with generated Client ID.

steps.title: Configure Authorized Redirect URIs
steps.purpose: Prevents authorization code interception by locking callbacks to your server.
steps.instructions: In the redirect settings, enter your callback URL. For local development, enter your local callback URL (e.g. "http://localhost:3000/api/auth/callback/hubspot"). Note: This example uses http://localhost:3000/ exclusively for local development testing, which HubSpot permits without SSL. For deployed staging and production applications, HTTPS is strictly mandatory and must match the registered domain character-for-character. Save changes.
steps.howToVerify: Confirm saved redirect URI appears under whitelisted callbacks with exact matching protocol.

steps.title: Select Permission Scopes & Secure Client Secret
steps.purpose: Configures granular API access permissions and obtains server credentials.
steps.instructions: Retrieve your Client ID and generate your Client Secret. Supported scopes: crm.objects.contacts.read (Read CRM contacts and company associations.), crm.objects.contacts.write (Create and update contacts and lifecycle stages.), crm.objects.deals.read (Read deal pipelines, stages, and revenue metrics.), crm.schemas.custom.read (Read custom CRM object schemas.). Scope location rule: Configured in the "Auth" tab of the app settings under "Scopes".. Store Client Secret in backend environment variables.
steps.expectedOutcome: Client Secret securely placed in server environment.
steps.howToVerify: Verify Client Secret string is copied and referenced in server .env without exposing in client code.
steps.commandOrSnippet:
HUBSPOT_CLIENT_ID="your_client_id_here"
HUBSPOT_CLIENT_SECRET="[REDACTED_CLIENT_SECRET]"
# Note: http://localhost:3000 is used for local development testing only; deployed production applications require HTTPS
REDIRECT_URI="http://localhost:3000/api/auth/callback"

steps.title: Implement HubSpot Authorization & Token Exchange
steps.purpose: Complete standard OAuth 2.0 (Authorization Code Grant) flow.
steps.whereToGo: Backend Callback Route & Client Auth Redirect Handler
steps.instructions: Direct users to authorization endpoint: "https://app.hubspot.com/oauth/authorize?client_id={CLIENT_ID}&response_type=code&redirect_uri={REDIRECT_URI}&scope=crm.objects.contacts.read%20crm.objects.contacts.write". Exchange authorization code by POSTing to token endpoint: "https://api.hubspot.com/oauth/v1/token".
steps.expectedOutcome: Server receives JSON payload containing access_token, token_type: Bearer, and expiration.
steps.howToVerify: Execute test code exchange and verify response JSON has 200 OK with valid access_token.

troubleshooting.description: Requested scope not enabled in the app configuration inside the HubSpot Developer Portal.
probableCauses: Scope was added to code request without selecting it in the developer portal Auth tab.
troubleshooting.resolution: Go to HubSpot Developer Dashboard > Apps > Auth > Scopes and check the box for the requested scope.
troubleshooting.symptom: Requested scope not enabled in the app configuration inside the HubSpot Developer Portal.
troubleshooting.diagnosis: Inspect request parameters against console configuration: Scope was added to code request without selecting it in the developer portal Auth tab.
troubleshooting.verification: Retry authorization request and confirm expected OAuth code or token response is returned.
troubleshooting.escalationPath: Capture provider error code and request details, excluding client secrets and access tokens, then consult HubSpot developer docs.
